items.title: Pay invoice for gutter renovation work
items.computation: Invoice date is 2026-11-20. 'Ab Rechnungsdatum' is an event-triggered civil-law period, so under §187(1) BGB the day of the invoice itself is not counted; the period begins on 2026-11-21. Under §188(1) BGB a period of 30 days ends on the day whose number corresponds to the day the period began, counted from 2026-11-21: 2026-11-21 to 2026-11-30 = 10 days, plus 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-20 = 20 days, totaling 30 days, so the period ends on 2026-12-20. Checking the weekday: 2026-11-24 is given as a Tuesday; 2026-12-20 is 26 days later (26 mod 7 = 5), so Tuesday+5 = Sunday. Since 2026-12-20 is a Sunday, §193 BGB shifts the deadline to the next working day, 2026-12-21 (a Monday, not a public holiday in NRW).
